E) NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNS:

THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO CLARIFY THE 'A4295/26' NOTAM ISSUED 
BY GREEK CAA. 
THE 'A4295/26' NOTAM ISSUED BY GREEK CAA CONSTITUES A BREACH OF 
GREECE'S TREATY OBLIGATIONS PERTAINING TO THE DEMILITARIZED STATUS 
OF EASTERN AEGEAN ISLANDS UNDER 'THE 1914 SIX POWER' DECISION 'THE 
1923 LAUSANNE PEACE TREATY'(WITH ITS ANNEX, THE CONVENTION RELATING 
TO THE REGIME OF THE STRAITS). BOZBABA(AYA EVSTRATIOS)
MENTIONED IN THE NOTAM AT REFERENCE HAS A DEMILITARISED STATUS . 
 BOZBABA(AYA EVSTRATIOS) AND/OR HER TERRITORY MUST NOT BE INCLUDED 
IN ANY SCENERIO/CONCEPT OF ANY MILITARY TRAINING OR EXERCISE.
